# `plasma::Display`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [ui](../ui.md) › `plasma::Display`

- **Kind:** class
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **Builds:** Cube.exe, Cube.exe only
- **C:** `plasma_Display` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("plasma_Display", address)`
- **Evidence:** `rtti:plasma::Display`, `probe:title-scene`
- **Confirmed by:** [title-scene](../probes.md#title-scene)

the part of a node that says how it is coloured and masked. The game's animation attributes (plasma::ContinuousAttribute and others) live in it, so it is large (at least 0x204 bytes)

## Fields

| Offset | Name | Type | Status | Confirmed by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x68 | `key` | `int32_t` | candidate |  | the index of the attribute value in use; the game reads and writes visible_values at this index |
| 0x94 | `visible_values` | `int32_t*` | candidate | [start-menu](../probes.md#start-menu) | the node's visibility: [visible_values + key * 4] is 1 when the node is shown and 0 when hidden. The game shows and hides its panels by writing this word (Start Game writes 0 to start_scene's and 1 to character_select's); 0x411C80 (node, bool) does the same for a node |
| 0x118 | `colour_index` | `uint32_t` | verified | [title-scene](../probes.md#title-scene) | the row of colour_table that the draw call uses; 0 for every node of the logo |
| 0x144 | `colour_table` | `float*` | verified | [title-scene](../probes.md#title-scene) | rows of 4 floats, RGBA. The draw call multiplies row colour_index by the colour its caller passes and gives that to the vertex shader as the shape's colour, so a node fades by its alpha here |
| 0x200 | `flags` | `uint32_t` | candidate |  | read by draw: bit 0, the node uses a mask or texture; bit 1, the mask is multiplied; otherwise bit 2 picks the mask's alpha only (set) or its colour over the shape (clear). These become the pixel shader's filter value 2, 3 or 1 |
